name: offside_dead_zone_outside
description: Boundary: the blue car is 205 uu upfield, 5 uu past the dead zone. By hand: severity 5/800 = 0.00625 per step, so about -0.0625 over 10 steps. The penalty ramps in smoothly; it does not jump to a large value at the edge.

expect.intent: 5 uu past the dead zone pays about -0.00625 per step: the penalty ramps in smoothly
the offside gate passes just outside the boundary
